cases.summary: 地图串起上海至关西的三日旅程。四角HUD持续报时，照片、回忆与分屏随120 BPM乐谱切换。
cases.focus: 以地图为稳定的背景，HUD持续更新，高光时切到全屏。60秒走过关西机场、伏见稻荷、鸭川、奈良公园和道顿堀。OpenStreetMap呈现3D建筑、铁路与水系。画面与乐谱共用一张时间表。

composition.color: 白天纸色#f1eee7与墨色#16171a。夜晚深蓝黑#0b1019，默认强调朱色#d9562c。鸭川青#2a8fae、奈良琥珀#c98a2a随章节切换。警示使用红色#e23b3b，路线、描边与框线同步换色。
composition.typography: 竖排片名与地名用Yu Mincho / Noto Serif JP明朝体。英文标题用Segoe UI Variable / Helvetica。数据用Cascadia Mono / JetBrains Mono等宽字体。数据字距放宽，结尾改用衬线。网站界面文字≥12px。
composition.layout: 固定画幅，两套构图。横屏1920×1080，边距64，规尺y=116。卡片靠右，大小824×464，地名靠左。右下印章与步进器同列。竖屏1080×1920，HUD在顶部276px内，规尺y=264。印章在右侧，968×544卡片放到下半屏。步进器在底部，fp单独控制竖屏取景。
composition.imagery: 场景包括关西机场机窗、千本鸟居、鸭川、奈良鹿与东大寺、道顿堀。每处各有照片、旧明信片、插画三种风格，按画幅重绘。可在film/config.js填入真实照片。
composition.motion: 镜头缓入缓出，长距离用单段ease-out推近。文字从模糊逐字变清晰。卡片550ms浮入、600ms展开。章节框线800ms描出，四角方块错峰回弹。盖章带回弹，结尾计数逐行堆叠。
composition.sound: 默认静音，开启后播放120 BPM整段乐谱。调式为D大调与日本阳音阶D E G A B。以环境声打底，叠加和弦、贝斯、半拍鼓组与拨弦。标记、文字、路线、卡片、印章与章节各配事件音。回忆段有黑胶与逐字钟，夜景配霓虹嗡鸣。结尾阳音阶上行后落到终止和弦。离线音轨峰值约-1.7 dBFS，无削波。导出视频时加--audio同步导出声音。
composition.rhythm: 120 BPM，1小节2秒，段落落在小节线上。约每4–6秒一个事件，每10–15秒一次地图与全屏切换。高光前后留1–2秒地图画面，缓和节奏。
composition.coherence: 全屏、回忆与对比共享HUD、颗粒和强调色。标记、路线端点、车头、引线与标签共用同一投影。

tokens.type: 明朝体竖排汉字 + 无衬线英文标题 + 等宽数据 + 衬线结尾；横屏 ≥ 24px、竖屏 ≥ 36px

motion.name: blur-in 逐字
motion.value: 550ms outCubic，字间160ms。模糊18px→0，上移14px→0。地名标题使用同样参数。

motion.name: type-in 打字
motion.value: 按字符推进，前沿字符带 7px 模糊

motion.name: card-in
motion.value: 550ms outCubic浮入，400ms inCubic离场。图片持续Ken Burns推近。

motion.name: card-expand
motion.value: 600ms inOutCubic展开。停2.2s，Ken Burns缩放1.04→1.10。550ms收回，HUD转白字，上下压暗。

motion.name: day-night
motion.value: 约 1s，逐图层插值；中途经过去饱和的灰，不整体反色

motion.name: chapter-frame
motion.value: 标签350ms擦出，标题700ms打字。框线800ms inOutCubic描出。四角方块120ms错峰，300ms outBack。

motion.name: split-compare
motion.value: 分割线750ms outQuart滑到中线。时间戳360ms outBack盖章。

motion.name: stamp
motion.value: 车站印章与步进器同列，按到达依次盖下（回弹 + 印章音）

motion.name: stat-stack
motion.value: 每行 320ms 错峰计数，衬线 fin. 在 2s 后

motion.name: buffering
motion.value: 缓冲<0.5s时暂停，显示BUFFERING MAP xx%。攒够4s继续。

observations.what: 竖排「関西周遊」从模糊变清，英文逐字打出，每字配键击。
左上显示日序和日期，右上显示坐标、海拔、缩放和时钟；左下显示曲名和歌词，右下显示步进器和印章。
鸟居卡片沿引线浮入，MIKAN计数上滚，随后盖下京都印章。
鸟居卡片铺满画面，HUD转白；呼啸后接低音，随后收回卡片，回到地图。
河畔插画中，「ゆく河の流れは」「絶えずして」竖排显影，逐字配钟声。
明信片与实景并排，「10.01·17:40 JST」斜戳配盖章声。
地图逐层转为深蓝黑，HUD变浅色，下扫呼啸接低音。
奈良卡片浮入，琥珀色斜纹胶带与网点标出章节。
红色WRONG TRAIN横幅擦入，REROUTING省略号与蜂鸣同拍。
3天4站、4枚印章、×4目击、1次误乘与194km逐行计数，钟声收尾。

avoid: 没有空间移动的内容
需要逐字阅读的长文
镜头要停在单一画面的访谈
constraints: 画面、文字、地点与乐谱共同呈现关西三日旅程。
照片、明信片与插画按画幅绘制。
OpenFreeMap底图与AWS高程显示建筑、铁路、水系和地名。
在 film/scenes.js 的 paintScene 修改程序场景；film/config.js 的 tracks.cards[] 设置场景类型与时刻。
约730块/130MB；约290块/66MB必需。10Mbps缓冲1–2次。
cases.prompt: 用 HTML/CSS/JS 制作一支 60 秒、可逐帧定位的“地图巡礼”影像，固定画幅两套构图：横屏 1920×1080 与竖屏 1080×1920（舞台像素坐标，整体等比缩放）。舞台字号按设计决定，不设下限；网站界面 ≥ 12px。内容：关西三日（上海 → 关西机场 → 京都伏见稻荷 → 鸭川 → 奈良公园 → 道顿堀），只用真实地名。①世界层：MapLibre GL + OpenFreeMap positron，隐藏全部文字标注，z14 起 3D 建筑，加 AWS Terrain Tiles 山体阴影（z5.5–13）；镜头关键帧 {t, center, zoom, pitch, bearing, 焦点位置 f / 竖屏 fp}，用 padding 把地点放到指定的屏幕位置；开场地球投影 + 星空；长距离用一段 ease-out 一口气推近。②昼夜：按图层类别逐个插值白天与夜晚配色，约 1 秒、中途经过去饱和的灰，不整体反色。③路线：航线虚线 + 飞机、铁路发光实线（line-gradient 按进度截断；几何从矢量瓦片里的 rail 线最短路提取）+ 车头、步行圆点、错误路线红线打叉；所有点位由同一个投影函数计算，端点与圆心严格重合。④HUD：左上 DAY 01 / 03 + 日期，右上坐标 / ELEV·Z / JST 时钟，顶部规尺按旅程进度填充，左下 NOW PLAYING + 双语歌词打字，右下步进器与车站印章（竖屏改为顶部 HUD + 右侧印章栏 + 底部步进器），计数徽章变化时上滚回弹。⑤事件：竖排汉字逐字模糊入场（550ms，字间 160ms）+ 英文模糊前沿打字；照片卡片浮入并用引线连到地图标记；卡片展开为全屏、HUD 保留并压暗；章节换强调色并描出四角框线 / 斜纹胶带；全屏插画回忆（独立框、档案标签、竖排字幕逐字）；分屏对比（分割线滑到中线 + 倾斜时间戳盖章）；红色 WRONG TRAIN 通栏 + REROUTING 胶囊；大号日序；结尾统计逐行计数 + 衬线 fin.。⑥标签避让：站名固定宽度 + 多个候选位置，避开 HUD 保留区与事件文字；文字永不压线。⑦声音：WebAudio 合成 120 BPM 乐谱（环境底、和弦、贝斯、鼓、阳音阶拨弦 + 每个事件的音），默认静音，可离线渲染 WAV。⑧工程：render(t) 纯函数，时间全部写进 config 轨道；window.__motion = {duration, seek(t)→Promise, play, pause, on}；?render=1 时 seek 等待瓦片；实时播放先扫描全片镜头需要的瓦片，再按时间顺序两级缓冲（下载 / 解析，内存预算，快速推拉帧的低价值瓦片降级），前方不足就暂停显示缓冲提示；颗粒用独立合成层平移；离线退回网格底图。
cases.videoPrompt: 60-second travel cutscene in the style of a video-game map interface, delivered in two fixed frames (1920×1080 landscape and 1080×1920 portrait with its own layout). A pale paper-colored 3D map of Japan's Kansai region (warm light-grey land, blue-grey water, white roads, thin grey railway lines, extruded white buildings in the city close-ups) is the persistent world; the camera glides with slow ease-in-out moves and gentle pitch. Fixed HUD: top-left 'DAY 01 / 03' with a monospace date, top-right latitude/longitude, 'ELEV 38 M · Z 14.1' and a large clock with a 'JST' superscript, a thin progress rule across the top, bottom-left 'NOW PLAYING' with an equalizer icon and bilingual lyric lines, bottom-right a four-stop stepper (KIX, KYOTO, NARA, OSAKA) with red station stamps. Beats: a night globe with stars → the map turns to day through grey → large vertical Japanese title characters '関西周遊' blur in one by one while 'KANSAI LOOP '26' types in → a dashed flight arc with a small plane sweeps from Shanghai and the camera dives straight into Kansai Airport → a glowing vermilion rail line draws along the real railway to Kyoto → close-up of Fushimi Inari with 3D buildings, a photo card of torii gates floats in with a thin leader line, then expands to full screen while the HUD stays on top → a teal chapter frame draws around the screen corners over the Kamo River → an illustrated flashback with its own frame and vertical Japanese subtitles revealing character by character → split screen: a divider slides to center revealing a 1930s sepia postcard against the modern river, a tilted timestamp stamps down → night falls on the map layer by layer, a handwritten note card drops in → day two: rail to Nara, deer park card with an amber tape decoration → a red 'WRONG TRAIN' banner wipes in, the wrong route turns red and ends with an X, a black 'REROUTING…' capsule blinks → night arrival at Dotonbori with neon and tall 3D blocks → the camera pulls back over the whole loop → stacked statistics count up and a serif 'fin.'. Clean, restrained, game-UI precision, subtle film grain, rhythmic edits on a 120 BPM beat, no camera shake.
cases.negativePrompt: 不要整体反色做夜景；不要让多个全屏模式叠在一起；不要把 HUD 做成满屏发光科幻风；不要用卡通贴纸替代信息层；不要在高缩放时保留地图文字标注抢走注意力；不要让镜头连续快速甩动；不要让文字压在路线或标记上；不要横竖画幅共用一套自适应排版；不要使用动画作品名称、截图或无授权的照片与音乐；不要在地图没加载完时露白（缓冲时停在当前帧并提示）。

migration.how: 设置片名、副标题、时区、总天数、时长与BPM。
设置地点名称、经纬度、海拔与最小缩放，路线端点自动对齐。
c中心、z缩放、p俯仰、b方位、f/fp取景、zp竖屏缩放、e缓动。
设置铁路与步行经纬度，可用rail图层或GeoJSON线。
调整各事件轨道时刻，画面与乐谱同步改变节奏。
设置章节标题、强调色、框线或胶带，以及四站步进器与印章。
设置和弦、阳音阶与到站提示音，按轨道生成乐谱。
分别设置横竖规尺、步进器、印章、卡片、避让区与统计区。
设置纸色、墨色、夜色、强调色与地图昼夜配色、样式和高程。
在 paintScene 修改程序绘制的照片、明信片与插画；tracks.cards[] 的 scene、caption、t、until、expand 设置场景、标签、时刻与展开。
设置开头门槛、解析与下载范围、内存预算、暂停与继续阈值。

composition.imagery: 档案与可拆解结构使用两份 GLB 模型。四十份档案可阅读，也可下载为文本。
composition.sound: 三轨配乐叠加交互合成音。逐字输入使用三个38ms短音轮替。
composition.typography: MiSans字体保持清楚的文字层级。字体包为misans-webfont@4.3.1。字体版本为4.003，网站界面文字≥12px。
composition.interaction: 选择档案时卡片抬起，镜头平滑跟随；通过页签、检索和收藏浏览资料，并可进入模型查看器拆解、重组结构。

motion.name: select-lift
motion.value: 选中抬起的临界阻尼速率4.2。

motion.name: idle
motion.value: 交互停止2.5s后进入空闲呼吸。

tokens.type: MiSans分片字体，文字层级随画面整体缩放。

observations.what: 五列档案：工程研究、生命科学、机构档案、能量研究、特别项目，每列八份。
选中的档案轻轻抬起，镜头沿阵列平滑跟随，停下时没有回弹。
编号与标题切换时滚动约 460ms，页签、检索、收藏随时可用。
读取档案时正文沿对角线逐块解密，约 3.6 秒完成。
横屏 1920×1080，画面整体等比缩放。
开机文字逐字打出，每个字都配一声短音。
22 秒展开阵列，35 秒读取第一份档案，62.6 秒起四向循环浏览。
开机、打字和每一次操作都有对应音效，全片 77.6 秒。

useCases: 数字资料馆与图形化目录
可渲染的终端风格影像
avoid: 需要高信息密度表格的后台
需要同时阅读多份长文档的资料工作台

cases.prompt: 制作莱茵生命档案终端：白底开场、五列循环档案阵列、对角解密、360°查看器与结构拆解。使用两份GLB、MiSans字体、三轨配乐、合成音效、逐字短音与四十份档案。固定画幅，60Hz时钟与统一音轨。开场后自动读取档案，再依次演示页签、360°查看器、六组结构拆解、重组、返回阵列与四向循环浏览。横屏1920×1080、竖屏1080×1920，按画幅排版。保留视觉、字号、文案、动效参数、缓动与音量声像。
cases.videoPrompt: A Rhine Lab archive terminal with a white opening, Rhine Lab identity, a five-column archive array, diagonal decryption, document tabs, a 360-degree model viewer, frosted and clear glass, a six-part exploded structure and reassembly. Include two GLB models, MiSans type, forty archive texts, three music tracks and sound. Use landscape 1920×1080 or portrait 1080×1920 layouts. Show the opening, archive reading, tabs, model viewer, disassembly, reassembly and four-direction browsing in sequence.
cases.negativePrompt: 保持视觉、布局、字号、文案、动效参数、缓动、模型、字体、档案和声音；不要增添外层UI、文字与装饰；不要裁剪或加速开场；保持动作序列。

migration.how: 在 archives.json 中修改四十份档案；在 src/scene.ts、src/model-viewer.ts 和相关样式中修改场景、模型查看器与外观。
修改演示节拍与页签、查看器、拆解、重组、浏览动作；离线音频入口为同目录 render-audio.mjs。
film/app/ 保存模型、字体与声音；art/build_archive.py、art/build_assembly.py 和两个 Blender 工程用于制作模型，用法见 art/README.md。

cases.title: 基林曲线 · 莫纳罗亚 CO₂ 数据短片
cases.subtitle: 同一条真实曲线，两种时间尺度
cases.summary: 20 秒短片先展开莫纳罗亚 CO₂ 真实月均曲线，再推近 2025 年的季节锯齿，拉远后并列呈现两端年均值：长期趋势，持续上升；起伏，是季节。
cases.focus: 同一条曲线保持数据点身份，用全局与近期两种尺度解释长期累积和季节起伏。月线覆盖 1958 年 3 月至 2025 年 12 月的 814 条 NOAA 官方发布记录，年均比较为 1959 年 315.98 ppm 与 2025 年 427.35 ppm。作品使用 garden-skills 的 motion-showreel skill，固定提交 2b9a89340b70f632d31c0f1c69fce94a7912423e，按其需求、brief、风格帧、逐镜头制作、混音、工作区预览与导出验收工作流制作。

layers.role: Kenney 轻木质落笔、柔软落点、确认点击各一次，主要瞬态分别对齐 0.500／10.346／17.300 秒；Demo 播放已经混好并母带处理的同一条成品音轨。

composition.color: 浅纸底 #F3F1E9、深墨 #202820、数据强调 #D85835、非焦点数据 #A5AAA0。图注 #697268，细轴线 #D7DACF，音乐署名 #92998F。强调色只编码主角和高亮数据。
composition.typography: 中文标题、正文、图注使用自托管 Noto Sans SC；展示数字与单位使用 IBM Plex Mono Medium。按 1920×1080 舞台排版，主标题 67–80px，展示数字 80–124px，来源与音乐署名均为 24px。
composition.layout: 只有横屏 1920×1080。大字在左上，折线图区域为 x=155–1760、y=445–865。左侧年均组基线 y=363，下沿 y=410，与纵轴标签、曲线顶部至少留 40px；来源 y=1030，音乐署名 y=1064。整体等比缩放。
composition.imagery: 无实拍图片。NOAA GML 月均 average 列形成真实锯齿，decimal date 为横坐标；全局范围 1958–2026／308–440 ppm，近景范围 2023–2026／414–434 ppm，数据只使用到 2025 年 12 月。
composition.motion: 月线按真实时间线性展开；横纵坐标跨度按对数插值，推近与拉远均用 ease.inOutCubic，两端速度归零。文字保持排版字号，数据落定后不弹跳、不滚动虚构数字。峰谷标签 0.300 秒、来源与音乐署名 0.350 秒，用 glide 缓动入场。
composition.sound: 默认关闭。开启后播放与最终成片一致的混音音轨，定位与播放跟随画面 t。BGM 为 Kevin MacLeod 的 Dreams Become Real，CC BY 4.0；三个 Kenney 音效为 CC0。音乐连续截取 7.162–27.162 秒，片内 100ms 淡入、末尾 1.5 秒淡出，无口播与合成声部；完整许可和署名见 Demo 的 source/AUDIO.md 与 audio/。
composition.rhythm: 名义 60 BPM，20 个音乐拍点由 candidate-1-beats-60.json 的 beats 减 7.162 秒得到。六段镜头边界保持 0／2.428／7.408／10.346／12.366／15.315／20 秒，不等同于音乐拍点；三个音效事件为 0.500／10.346／17.300 秒。能量值由 Motion Atlas 依据成片的运动量与停留时间估计，不是 skill brief 中给出的数值。
composition.coherence: 同一条真实月线贯穿全片，全局与近景只改变坐标映射和高亮。年均比较、月均端点与季节峰谷各自标明口径，纸底、字体、细轴线和单一强调色保持一致。

tokens.type: Noto Sans SC 400／600／700 + IBM Plex Mono Medium 500；中文主标题 67–80px，展示数字 80–124px，来源与音乐署名 24px。

motion.name: 2025 高亮与峰谷
motion.value: 10.346 秒开始；2025 折线 5px，邻年退灰。峰谷标签 glide 0.300 秒，曲线和数字不超调。事件入场进度包含一个 30fps 帧步长。

motion.name: 比例尺拉远
motion.value: 12.366–15.315 秒，共 2.949 秒。与推近共用坐标空间和 ease.inOutCubic，回到完整月线。

motion.name: 来源与音乐署名
motion.value: 17.300 秒开始，glide 0.350 秒；透明度 0→1，纵向位移 12px→0。事件入场进度包含一个 30fps 帧步长；事件前完全不可见。

motion.name: 三个音效主要瞬态
motion.value: 0.500／10.346／17.300 秒；按原文件主要瞬态偏移定位，不把文件起点当作落点。

observations.what: 建立标题、坐标与 1959 年均读数，首笔之前不预画曲线。
早期锯齿直接延伸到完整历史序列，不清空重画；月点位置和折角均来自原始数据。
同一条曲线在坐标空间中连续推近，文字保持字号；2025 的峰谷高亮不提前出现。
2025 高亮与峰谷标签入场；五月 430.51 ppm、九月 424.37 ppm 分别标在真实月点。
固定全局落版，把 1959 年均 315.98 ppm 与 2025 年均 427.35 ppm 并列；不将年均值贴到月线末点。
数据来源与音乐署名入场后保持显示，留出阅读时间；音乐从 18.5 秒开始淡出。

useCases: 公开时间序列的数据短片
长期趋势与周期变化的双尺度解释
需要来源、单位与数据口径并列呈现的动态图表
avoid: 无法追溯来源的数字叙事
把莫纳罗亚观测序列当作全球平均
需要逐字阅读长篇解释的内容
需要竖屏重新排版的交付
constraints: 成片 20 秒、1920×1080、30fps，只有横屏，不作无缝循环。
制作方式：garden-skills 的 motion-showreel skill，固定提交 2b9a89340b70f632d31c0f1c69fce94a7912423e；原始 skill brief 随 Demo 原样保存。
数据许可：NOAA GML 免费公开数据，发表需相应引用与署名；保留 Xin Lan（NOAA/GML）、Ralph Keeling（Scripps）及早期 C. David Keeling／Scripps 归属，具体要求见 source/DATA.md。
声音许可：Dreams Become Real，Kevin MacLeod／Incompetech，CC BY 4.0，须保留完整署名并说明截取、淡入淡出与混音；Kenney Impact Sounds 和 UI Audio 为 CC0，包内 License.txt 随音轨保留，见 source/AUDIO.md。
自托管 Noto Sans SC 与 IBM Plex Mono 附各自 OFL 许可。
814 条月均记录只取 1958-03 至 2025-12；年均比较只用 annual 第 46／112 行。2022 年末至 2023 年中的临时代测记录按 NOAA 官方连续序列保留。
画面保留 ppm、年均／月均口径、非零纵轴说明与来源；不补造 1958 年一二月，不生成无来源的中间数字。
能量值由 Motion Atlas 依据成片的运动量与停留时间估计，不是 skill brief 中给出的数值。六段使用精确时间端点，段内线性，边界可跳变。
实现 Prompt、视频生成 Prompt 与负向约束均由 Motion Atlas 依据 brief 撰写，不冒充原 skill 输出。
cases.prompt: 由 Motion Atlas 依据 brief 撰写。用 HTML、Canvas 2D 与 JavaScript 制作 20 秒、1920×1080、30fps 的中文基林曲线数据短片，只提供横屏。读取 NOAA 原始 co2_mm_mlo.txt 的 decimal date 与 average 列，使用 1958-03 至 2025-12 的 814 个官方发布月点；年度比较读取 co2_annmean_mlo.txt，1959 年均 315.98 ppm、2025 年均 427.35 ppm。纸底 #F3F1E9、深墨 #202820、主线 #D85835、上下文线 #A5AAA0，中文 Noto Sans SC、数字 IBM Plex Mono Medium，自托管并保留 OFL。图表区域 x=155–1760、y=445–865，单位和数字相邻，显示「纵轴未从零开始」。①0.000–2.428 秒：标题「地球在「呼吸」。」「但 CO₂ 的底线，逐年抬高。」与 1959 年均；0.500 秒首笔才出现，从 1958 年三月开始线性展开到 1964。②2.428–7.408 秒：同一端点续画到 2025 年十二月，标题「同一条曲线，两种尺度。」「每个点，对应一次月均记录。」；不清空重画。③7.408–10.346 秒：在同一坐标空间连续推近，横纵跨度按对数插值，ease.inOutCubic；全局 1958–2026／308–440 ppm 转到近景 2023–2026／414–434 ppm，文字字号保持。④10.346–12.366 秒：固定近景，2025 月线用 5px 橙线突出、邻年退灰，标题「起伏，是季节。」「北半球植被生长与衰退」；真实五月峰 430.51 ppm、九月谷 424.37 ppm 以 glide 0.300 秒入场，不提前出现。⑤12.366–15.315 秒：沿原坐标空间用同一三次缓动拉远，恢复全局线色。⑥15.315–20.000 秒：落版「长期趋势，持续上升。」「起伏，是季节。」与两端年均值；左年均基线 y=363、下沿 y=410，与纵轴标签、曲线顶部均保持至少 40px。17.300 秒才入场「数据：NOAA GML · 莫纳罗亚观测站 CO₂ 月均值」，下一行「音乐：“Dreams Become Real” Kevin MacLeod（incompetech.com）· CC BY 4.0」，均 24px，glide 0.350 秒、纵移 12px→0，音乐署名更淡。声音默认关闭；开启后播放已完成的最终混音：Dreams Become Real 原曲 7.162–27.162 秒，不变速，片内 0–0.100 秒线性淡入、18.5–20 秒线性淡出，三个 Kenney 音效主要瞬态在 0.500、10.346、17.300 秒。无口播、无合成声部。作品代码置于 film/，入口使用 MotionKit.mountFilm，画面由 render(t) 绘制；提供 window.__motion，seek(t) 等待画面完成；支持 ?embed、?render、?t=秒、逐帧步进、默认静音与减少动态偏好，音轨按时间轴同步。
cases.videoPrompt: 由 Motion Atlas 依据 brief 撰写。生成一支 20 秒、1920×1080、30fps、横屏中文数据短片。整片使用 #F3F1E9 浅纸底、#202820 深墨中文标题、IBM Plex Mono 等宽数字与一条 #D85835 真实月均折线，灰色细轴线与大面积留白。主体始终是同一份 NOAA 莫纳罗亚 CO₂ 月均序列，1958 年三月至 2025 年十二月；不得用装饰性正弦曲线替代。0.000–2.428 秒出现「地球在「呼吸」。」「但 CO₂ 的底线，逐年抬高。」与「1959 · 年均 CO₂」「315.98 ppm」；0.500 秒首笔落下，再展开早期真实锯齿。2.428–7.408 秒，线条从同一端点继续画到 2025，文字为「同一条曲线，两种尺度。」「每个点，对应一次月均记录。」。7.408–10.346 秒沿同一坐标空间平滑推近 2023–2025，三次对称缓动、两端速度归零，文字保持清晰。10.346–12.366 秒固定近景，仅高亮 2025 年完整月线、邻年退灰；标题「起伏，是季节。」、副标题「北半球植被生长与衰退」，标注五月 430.51 ppm 与九月 424.37 ppm。12.366–15.315 秒连续拉远回到历史全景。15.315–20.000 秒保留全线，落版「长期趋势，持续上升。」「起伏，是季节。」并列「1959 · 年均 CO₂」「315.98 ppm」与「2025 · 年均 CO₂」「427.35 ppm」。17.300 秒入场数据来源和 Kevin MacLeod 的 CC BY 4.0 音乐署名，24px，来源下方署名更淡。全程保留 ppm、年均／月均口径与「纵轴未从零开始」。声音只用获许可的 Dreams Become Real 连续区间 7.162–27.162 秒，100ms 淡入、最后 1.5 秒淡出；Kenney 木质落笔、柔软落点、确认点击各一次，主要瞬态在 0.500／10.346／17.300 秒。无口播，非循环。
cases.negativePrompt: 由 Motion Atlas 依据 brief 撰写。不要编造、补造、拟合或平滑掉真实月均锯齿；不要补出 1958 年一二月；不要混入 2026 数据；不要把年均 315.98／427.35 ppm 贴到月均端点，月线首末点为 315.71／427.49 ppm；不要添加源文件没有的增量、百分比或滚动中间数字；不要把莫纳罗亚序列称作全球平均，不要说每个月都上升或每年都在五月达峰；不要省略来源、单位、年均／月均口径与非零纵轴说明；不要提前显示峰谷高亮或来源；不要替换另一条曲线做推近，不要让文字随镜头缩小，不要用弹簧让数据超调或持续晃动；不要深色发光 HUD、渐变、扫描线、粒子、噪点、镜头抖动、全画面反色、默认全体淡入；不要新增竖屏构图；不要口播、合成声部、史诗鼓点、欢快 ukulele、第四个音效或未批准素材；不要省略 CC BY 4.0 完整署名与 Kenney 包内许可。

cases.prompt:
You are the director, motion designer, engineer and sound designer of ONE 10-second motion-design film.
The goal is the most classic, yet most stunning form of this style — award-shortlist / high-end commercial quality. A clean,
template-looking result is a fail. Benchmarks: Buck, ManvsMachine, Ordinary Folk, Giant Ant, Territory Studio, Apple keynote
motion, Pentagram motion identities, top Behance/Motionographer features, top 抖音/B站 designer accounts.

# Style
逐帧手绘 / 线条沸腾 Cel Animation / Frame-by-Frame & Line Boil

# Output (fixed)
- 1920×1080, 24 fps, exactly 10.000 s (240 frames), H.264 MP4 with stereo AAC audio (48 kHz), mastered to −14 LUFS
  integrated, true peak ≤ −1 dBTP. Final file: video.mp4.

# Suggested technical route
HTML Canvas2D: custom variable-width brush renderer (centreline + pressure → outline polygon), boil = 3–4 jitter variants cycled every 2 frames; paper texture multiply
(You may choose a better route if it clearly raises quality; say why.)

# Creative seed
「手作魔法」Hand-made frame-by-frame magic, Buck/Giant-Ant hybrid (clean shapes + hand-drawn cel FX), animated on 2s at 24 fps.
- Warm paper ground; ink linework that BOILS (lines redrawn with slight variation every 2 frames); fills slightly off-register like hand colouring.
- Story: a matchstick strikes (SMEAR frame, on 1s for the fast action) → a flame spirit character jumps out, anticipation + squash, dances (on 2s) → it bursts into cel FX: smoke puffs curling, sparks, star bursts, speed lines → the FX re-form into hand-lettered title (e.g. "HAND MADE" or 手作) that keeps boiling on a 1s hold (on 3s for the hold).
- Palette 3–4 colours: ink black, tomato red, sunny yellow, cream paper; paper grain multiply 10–15%.
Sound: playful jazzy pizzicato/xylophone bed + cartoon SFX: strike, fwoosh, pop, poof, sparkle — synced to the frame.

You are the director: you may change the concept, copy, story beats and brand names if you find a stronger idea, but the result must remain the CANONICAL, instantly-recognisable form of this style and must hit its signature features below.

# Signature features and key techniques (the result is judged against these)
手绘逐帧或在矢量动画上叠加逐帧质感，标志性特征是 line boil——线条每隔几帧轻微抖动，仿佛画面在'呼吸'。Giant Ant、Buck 等工作室大量使用 cel 元素（烟、水花、速度线）点缀主动画，反数字精致感的核心手段。
视觉特征 线条持续微抖(boil), 一拍二/一拍三节奏, smear拖影帧, 手绘烟火水花点缀, 纸纹底
关键技法 打帧节奏：24fps 下'一拍二'（实际12fps）为主，快动作切'一拍一'，静止镜头'一拍三'
line boil 伪造法：AE 用 Turbulent Displace（数量2~5、大小50）+ 每 2 帧随机化 evolution + Posterize Time 12fps；真 boil 则画 3~4 张微差线稿循环
smear frame：快速位移的中间帧把物体拉长 150%~300% 只保留 1 帧
cel FX 点缀层：烟/水花/闪电用纯手绘逐帧叠在矢量主体上（Buck 式 hybrid）
整体叠纸纹（multiply 10~15%）统一手作气质

# How to work
1. Treatment. Write down one clear idea: a hook in the first 0.5 s (never open on more than 0.3 s of empty or black), an
   escalation, one unmistakable hero moment at ~60–75 % of the runtime, and a composed end frame held ~0.8–1.2 s with living
   micro-motion. Map every signature feature above to a moment. Keep one cue sheet (beats and hit times) that both the
   picture and the sound read from.
2. Key frames before motion. Build the look, render stills at 6–10 key times and actually look at them. Each still should be
   poster-worthy: composition, hierarchy, negative space, type set properly (kerning, line-height, weight contrast, CJK
   punctuation, ~5 % safe margins). Iterate until nothing looks default, generic, cramped or "AI-template".
3. Motion. Build the choreography and preview at low resolution. Step through the fastest moves frame by frame: spacing,
   easing, arcs, overlap, anticipation and follow-through, motion blur. No unintended dead spans; the energy follows the music.
4. Sound. Write genre-correct music and sound design locked to the cue sheet. Check that visual hits land on audio onsets.
   Master to the output spec.
5. Final. Render at full resolution (motion blur where apt), then check: exactly 10.00 s, resolution, fps, audio present and at
   the right loudness, no black frames, no fallback fonts or tofu, no clipped elements at the frame edges, no shimmer on thin
   lines, no gradient banding. Fix and repeat until you would submit it to a festival.
6. Write an honest self-critique: what is strongest, what is weakest, what you would do with more time.

# Rules
- Rendering must be deterministic: every frame is a pure function of time t. Seeded randomness only; physics and particles
  precomputed or closed-form; no real-time clocks; no state-triggered CSS transitions. A reliable route: a web page that can
  draw any time t on request, captured frame by frame with a headless browser and encoded with ffmpeg (or a Blender script
  that renders a PNG sequence).
- Assets: only CC0 / public domain / OFL / Apache / free-for-commercial-use. Record each source and licence in CREDITS.md.
  No real brand trademarks; invent brand names.
- On-screen text must be correct and natural: idiomatic Chinese, proper CJK punctuation, no typos.

# Craft checklist (what a jury looks for)
- Style authenticity: an expert names the style in one second; every signature technique is present and executed correctly.
- Motion craft: purposeful easing (no linear unless mechanical by design), overlap and stagger, anticipation and
  follow-through, arcs, squash and stretch where the style allows, consistent physics, motion blur where apt; transitions
  carried by elements, not crossfades.
- Rhythm: hits locked to the music; contrast between busy and calm; no monotony.
- Design: strong composition, grid, typographic hierarchy, controlled palette; texture and finishing (grain, glow, vignette)
  only where the style wants it; nothing looks accidental.
- Technical polish: no jitter (unless intended), no popping, no aliasing, no banding, no fallback fonts, no half-loaded images.
- Sound: genre-correct, musical, synced, mastered.

# Before you deliver, score yourself honestly
1–10 on style fidelity, concept wow, motion craft, design & typography, finish & texture, sound & sync, technical
(6 = template-level, 8 = high-end agency, 9 = award shortlist). Aim for 9; fix whatever scores lowest first.

# Deliver
video.mp4, plus a short report: the concept in two sentences; a beat sheet with timecodes; how each signature feature is
realised; the tech route; check numbers (duration, resolution, fps, loudness, true peak); your honest top-3 weaknesses.

composition.motion: 地块倾斜落地并微微回弹；建筑基座先落、墙体弹性伸展、屋顶延后；核心塔套筒伸出后激活全城，信息卡沿等轴面展开，字母翻落在地面。
composition.sound: 复用原片 120 BPM、D 大调的马林巴与钟琴配乐及对应音效，播放从原片无损抽取的 AAC 音轨。
composition.rhythm: 地块环从 0.25 至 1.5 秒逐圈落位，核心塔从 4.625 秒开始组装，6 秒激活，6.5、6.75、7 秒展开信息卡，7.75 至 8.75 秒拉远，9 秒揭示标语。
composition.coherence: 同一城市按共享时间表从蓝图、灰模生长进入激活运行；青色网格与传播波贯穿开场、核心落点和标题落版。

cases.prompt:
You are the director, motion designer, engineer and sound designer of ONE 10-second motion-design film.
The goal is the most classic, yet most stunning form of this style — award-shortlist / high-end commercial quality. A clean,
template-looking result is a fail. Benchmarks: Buck, ManvsMachine, Ordinary Folk, Giant Ant, Territory Studio, Apple keynote
motion, Pentagram motion identities, top Behance/Motionographer features, top 抖音/B站 designer accounts.

# Style
等轴 2.5D Isometric / 2.5D

# Output (fixed)
- 1920×1080, 30 fps, exactly 10.000 s (300 frames), H.264 MP4 with stereo AAC audio (48 kHz), mastered to −14 LUFS
  integrated, true peak ≤ −1 dBTP. Final file: video.mp4.

# Suggested technical route
HTML: Three.js OrthographicCamera at true isometric angle + soft shadows + AO (three/addons postprocessing), or SVG with SSR matrix faces
(You may choose a better route if it clearly raises quality; say why.)

# Creative seed
「微缩智慧城」An isometric miniature city / data campus that builds itself — the School-of-Motion isometric mograph showpiece.
- True isometric camera (orthographic, 35.264° elevation, 45° azimuth), no perspective, pastel studio palette (lavender ground, mint, peach, sky blue, white) with soft shadows + ambient occlusion so it reads like a premium Dribbble/Behance hero.
- 0–2s: ground tiles flip/drop in as a wave from the centre (tiny bounce each);
- 2–5s: buildings GROW — base lands, walls scaleY from 0 with overshoot, roof caps 2–3 frames later; trees pop; windows light up in sequence;
- 5–8s: life — cars loop along roads, a little train, drones carrying packets, glowing data streams pulse between buildings, a wind turbine spins; camera does parallel slides (no rotation) with 1 : 0.8 : 0.6 parallax layers (foreground clouds);
- 8–10s: pull back to reveal the whole island floating in a pastel void; title card set ON the isometric plane (text skewed into iso space) e.g. "SMART CITY OS".
Sound: bright plucky tech melody (FM marimba/pluck), soft clicks/pops for every tile/building landing, airy whoosh on the pull-back.

You are the director: you may change the concept, copy, story beats and brand names if you find a stronger idea, but the result must remain the CANONICAL, instantly-recognisable form of this style and must hit its signature features below.

# Signature features and key techniques (the result is judged against these)
以 30° 等轴测投影展示微缩世界：小城市、办公室切片、数据机房，无灭点、处处等比。信息密度高又不失可爱，是科技公司架构图动画和 App 功能演示的标配。School of Motion 有专门的 isometric mograph 教程系列。
视觉特征 30°等角投影, 无透视灭点, 微缩场景, 楼房生长动画, 平行滑轨式运镜
关键技法 SSR 公式造等轴面：Scale 纵向 86.6% → Shear/skew ±30° → Rotate ∓30°，三个面分别做后拼合
假 3D 靠图层排序：Z 序=画面 y 坐标，物体沿等轴网格移动时保持 2:1 像素斜率
楼房'生长'：底面先落位，立面用 scaleY 从 0 拉起 + 顶面延迟 2~3 帧盖上

   escalation, one unmistakable hero moment at ~60–75 % of the runtime, and a composed end frame held ~0.8–1.2 s with living
   micro-motion. Map every signature feature above to a moment. Keep one cue sheet (beats and hit times) that both the
   picture and the sound read from.
2. Key frames before motion. Build the look, render stills at 6–10 key times and actually look at them. Each still should be
   poster-worthy: composition, hierarchy, negative space, type set properly (kerning, line-height, weight contrast, CJK
   punctuation, ~5 % safe margins). Iterate until nothing looks default, generic, cramped or "AI-template".
3. Motion. Build the choreography and preview at low resolution. Step through the fastest moves frame by frame: spacing,
   easing, arcs, overlap, anticipation and follow-through, motion blur. No unintended dead spans; the energy follows the music.
4. Sound. Write genre-correct music and sound design locked to the cue sheet. Check that visual hits land on audio onsets.
   Master to the output spec.
5. Final. Render at full resolution (motion blur where apt), then check: exactly 10.00 s, resolution, fps, audio present and at
   the right loudness, no black frames, no fallback fonts or tofu, no clipped elements at the frame edges, no shimmer on thin
   lines, no gradient banding. Fix and repeat until you would submit it to a festival.

  precomputed or closed-form; no real-time clocks; no state-triggered CSS transitions. A reliable route: a web page that can
  draw any time t on request, captured frame by frame with a headless browser and encoded with ffmpeg (or a Blender script
  that renders a PNG sequence).
- Assets: only CC0 / public domain / OFL / Apache / free-for-commercial-use. Record each source and licence in CREDITS.md.
  No real brand trademarks; invent brand names.
- On-screen text must be correct and natural: idiomatic Chinese, proper CJK punctuation, no typos.

# Craft checklist (what a jury looks for)
- Style authenticity: an expert names the style in one second; every signature technique is present and executed correctly.
- Motion craft: purposeful easing (no linear unless mechanical by design), overlap and stagger, anticipation and
  follow-through, arcs, squash and stretch where the style allows, consistent physics, motion blur where apt; transitions
  carried by elements, not crossfades.
- Rhythm: hits locked to the music; contrast between busy and calm; no monotony.
- Design: strong composition, grid, typographic hierarchy, controlled palette; texture and finishing (grain, glow, vignette)
  only where the style wants it; nothing looks accidental.
- Technical polish: no jitter (unless intended), no popping, no aliasing, no banding, no fallback fonts, no half-loaded images.
- Sound: genre-correct, musical, synced, mastered.

# Before you deliver, score yourself honestly
1–10 on style fidelity, concept wow, motion craft, design & typography, finish & texture, sound & sync, technical
(6 = template-level, 8 = high-end agency, 9 = award shortlist). Aim for 9; fix whatever scores lowest first.

# Deliver
video.mp4, plus a short report: the concept in two sentences; a beat sheet with timecodes; how each signature feature is
realised; the tech route; check numbers (duration, resolution, fps, loudness, true peak); your honest top-3 weaknesses.

cases.prompt:
You are the director, motion designer, engineer and sound designer of ONE 10-second motion-design film.
The goal is the most classic, yet most stunning form of this style — award-shortlist / high-end commercial quality. A clean,
template-looking result is a fail. Benchmarks: Buck, ManvsMachine, Ordinary Folk, Giant Ant, Territory Studio, Apple keynote
motion, Pentagram motion identities, top Behance/Motionographer features, top 抖音/B站 designer accounts.

# Style
线条动画 Line Art / Line Animation

# Output (fixed)
- 1920×1080, 30 fps, exactly 10.000 s (300 frames), H.264 MP4 with stereo AAC audio (48 kHz), mastered to −14 LUFS
  integrated, true peak ≤ −1 dBTP. Final file: video.mp4.

# Suggested technical route
HTML: SVG paths + stroke-dashoffset (getTotalLength) + GSAP; a virtual camera that follows the pen tip
(You may choose a better route if it clearly raises quality; say why.)

# Creative seed
「一笔画」One-line narrative for a luxury / architecture brand — the whole film is ONE continuous line.
- Deep midnight ground (#0B1320 or near-black) + a single champagne-gold line (#E9D7A5), constant ~3px, round caps, a softly glowing pen tip that leads the draw.
- Story (continuous path, the tail of each figure is the start of the next): a seed → sprouts into a sapling → branches become the structural lines of a building → the building outline extends into a skyline/horizon → the horizon line lifts and loops into a monogram logo → LINE-TO-FILL moment (logo fills with gold from its anchor) → thin letter-spaced serif wordmark (e.g. "ATELIER LINEA") fades up.
- Draw speed eases into corners (cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)); the virtual camera drifts/pushes to keep the tip in frame, then dollies out at the end to reveal the whole drawing composed as a poster; older line segments dim to ~35% as the camera moves on.
Sound: minimal felt piano + soft string swell; a pen-on-paper whisper whose loudness follows tip speed; delicate chime on the fill.

You are the director: you may change the concept, copy, story beats and brand names if you find a stronger idea, but the result must remain the CANONICAL, instantly-recognisable form of this style and must hit its signature features below.

# Signature features and key techniques (the result is judged against these)
以单色细线为唯一造型语言，线条自我描绘（draw-on）、延伸、转折并变形为下一个图形，一笔连成整支片子。极简高级感强，常见于奢侈品、金融、建筑类品牌片和 logo 动画。
视觉特征 等宽细线, 单色或双色, 大量负空间, 线条连续生长, 线面转换瞬间
关键技法 核心是 stroke 描绘：AE 用 Trim Paths 0→100%，Web 端用 SVG stroke-dasharray/dashoffset
线宽全片恒定（2~4px），转角处让描绘速度略减速，用 easeInOut cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)
'一笔画'叙事：上一图形的尾线即下一图形的起线，路径提前在 Illustrator 里连好
线转面：描完轮廓后用同路径的 fill 从锚点扩展填充
配合微小的端点圆头（round cap）与路径抖动可增加手绘感

# How to work
1. Treatment. Write down one clear idea: a hook in the first 0.5 s (never open on more than 0.3 s of empty or black), an
   escalation, one unmistakable hero moment at ~60–75 % of the runtime, and a composed end frame held ~0.8–1.2 s with living
   micro-motion. Map every signature feature above to a moment. Keep one cue sheet (beats and hit times) that both the
   picture and the sound read from.
2. Key frames before motion. Build the look, render stills at 6–10 key times and actually look at them. Each still should be
   poster-worthy: composition, hierarchy, negative space, type set properly (kerning, line-height, weight contrast, CJK
   punctuation, ~5 % safe margins). Iterate until nothing looks default, generic, cramped or "AI-template".
3. Motion. Build the choreography and preview at low resolution. Step through the fastest moves frame by frame: spacing,
   easing, arcs, overlap, anticipation and follow-through, motion blur. No unintended dead spans; the energy follows the music.
4. Sound. Write genre-correct music and sound design locked to the cue sheet. Check that visual hits land on audio onsets.
   Master to the output spec.
5. Final. Render at full resolution (motion blur where apt), then check: exactly 10.00 s, resolution, fps, audio present and at
   the right loudness, no black frames, no fallback fonts or tofu, no clipped elements at the frame edges, no shimmer on thin
   lines, no gradient banding. Fix and repeat until you would submit it to a festival.
6. Write an honest self-critique: what is strongest, what is weakest, what you would do with more time.

# Rules
- Rendering must be deterministic: every frame is a pure function of time t. Seeded randomness only; physics and particles
  precomputed or closed-form; no real-time clocks; no state-triggered CSS transitions. A reliable route: a web page that can
  draw any time t on request, captured frame by frame with a headless browser and encoded with ffmpeg (or a Blender script
  that renders a PNG sequence).
- Assets: only CC0 / public domain / OFL / Apache / free-for-commercial-use. Record each source and licence in CREDITS.md.
  No real brand trademarks; invent brand names.
- On-screen text must be correct and natural: idiomatic Chinese, proper CJK punctuation, no typos.

# Craft checklist (what a jury looks for)
- Style authenticity: an expert names the style in one second; every signature technique is present and executed correctly.
- Motion craft: purposeful easing (no linear unless mechanical by design), overlap and stagger, anticipation and
  follow-through, arcs, squash and stretch where the style allows, consistent physics, motion blur where apt; transitions
  carried by elements, not crossfades.
- Rhythm: hits locked to the music; contrast between busy and calm; no monotony.
- Design: strong composition, grid, typographic hierarchy, controlled palette; texture and finishing (grain, glow, vignette)
  only where the style wants it; nothing looks accidental.
- Technical polish: no jitter (unless intended), no popping, no aliasing, no banding, no fallback fonts, no half-loaded images.
- Sound: genre-correct, musical, synced, mastered.

# Before you deliver, score yourself honestly
1–10 on style fidelity, concept wow, motion craft, design & typography, finish & texture, sound & sync, technical
(6 = template-level, 8 = high-end agency, 9 = award shortlist). Aim for 9; fix whatever scores lowest first.

# Deliver
video.mp4, plus a short report: the concept in two sentences; a beat sheet with timecodes; how each signature feature is
realised; the tech route; check numbers (duration, resolution, fps, loudness, true peak); your honest top-3 weaknesses.

cases.prompt:
# 3D 渲染系（C4D/Blender 质感） 3D Render / CGI Motion Design

**原片**：soft.「Soft Landing 柔软着陆」 · 1920×1080 · 24 fps · 10 秒 · AI 评审终评 7.71 / 10

**源码**：[demos/04-3d-render/](../demos/04-3d-render/)

## 怎么用

1. 新建一个空文件夹，在里面打开一个能写代码、能执行命令的 AI 助手（例如 Claude Code）。本机需要能跑网页渲染（Node + Chrome）和 ffmpeg；这种风格建议的路线要用 Blender。
2. 把下面「提示词」整段复制进去发送。
3. 想换成自己的内容：改 `Creative seed` 里的故事、品牌名、文案和配色，或者改 `Output` 里的尺寸（比如竖屏 1080×1920）。不要删 `Signature features` 那一段，它是这种风格被一眼认出来的依据。
4. 想再提高：成片出来后，另开一个 AI 用 [rubric.md](../rubric.md) 评审，把评审意见贴回给制作的 AI 再改一轮。原片就是这样改了两轮。

## 提示词

```text
You are the director, motion designer, engineer and sound designer of ONE 10-second motion-design film.
The goal is the most classic, yet most stunning form of this style — award-shortlist / high-end commercial quality. A clean,
template-looking result is a fail. Benchmarks: Buck, ManvsMachine, Ordinary Folk, Giant Ant, Territory Studio, Apple keynote
motion, Pentagram motion identities, top Behance/Motionographer features, top 抖音/B站 designer accounts.

# Style
3D 渲染系（C4D/Blender 质感） 3D Render / CGI Motion Design

# Output (fixed)
- 1920×1080, 24 fps, exactly 10.000 s (240 frames), H.264 MP4 with stereo AAC audio (48 kHz), mastered to −14 LUFS
  integrated, true peak ≤ −1 dBTP. Final file: video.mp4.

# Suggested technical route
Blender 5.1.2 CLI (bpy script → Cycles on Metal GPU with OIDN denoise, or EEVEE if it holds quality) → PNG sequence → ffmpeg; optional HTML overlay pass for typography
(You may choose a better route if it clearly raises quality; say why.)

# Creative seed
「Soft & Satisfying」The C4D/Octane pastel product-ident look (Maxon demo-reel vibe): soft candy materials, cloner arrays, physics-feel motion.
- Pastel studio: infinite cyc backdrop, big soft area lights + HDRI (see /assets/hdri), shallow DOF (f/1.8 feel), 24 fps, real motion blur.
- A MoGraph-style cloner field (geometry-nodes grid of glossy rounded pills/spheres) ripples with an effector wave; a hero object — inflated/bevelled 3D wordmark (e.g. "SOFT" or an invented brand) or a glossy jelly logo — drops in, squash-and-stretch jiggle (damped spring), collides with and displaces the cloner field.
- Material trio: SSS gummy (candy pink / peach), glossy plastic (cream / lilac), frosted glass or chrome accent — with AO, soft reflections, subtle subsurface glow.
- Camera: long-tail ease (80% of the move in the first 20%), ends on a clean hero composition held ~1s.
Sound: ASMR-satisfying soft thuds, squishes, bubbly pops, airy cinematic pad; hits frame-synced to impacts.

You are the director: you may change the concept, copy, story beats and brand names if you find a stronger idea, but the result must remain the CANONICAL, instantly-recognisable form of this style and must hit its signature features below.

# Signature features and key techniques (the result is judged against these)
Cinema 4D + Redshift/Octane 或 Blender 渲染的实体质感动画：软胶、玻璃、金属、布料，配合克隆阵列和物理模拟。是高端产品片（手机、饮料、球鞋）和品牌 ident 的主流，Maxon 官方 Demo Reel 就是该风格的年度风向标。
视觉特征 PBR真实材质, 浅景深, 柔和棚拍布光, 克隆器阵列, 软体碰撞, 糖果色软胶质感
关键技法 MoGraph 核心：Cloner 克隆器 + Random/Plain Effector 做群体波浪式动画
质感三件套：SSS 次表面散射（软胶感）+ AO + HDRI 三点布光
运动多用长尾 ease：位移曲线前 20% 完成 80% 路程，收尾极慢，配 motion blur
24/25fps 电影帧率 + 浅景深（f/1.8 感）区别于 2D 系的 30fps 利落感
常见结构：产品为轴心，粒子/流体/布料围绕它做物理模拟编排

# How to work
1. Treatment. Write down one clear idea: a hook in the first 0.5 s (never open on more than 0.3 s of empty or black), an
   escalation, one unmistakable hero moment at ~60–75 % of the runtime, and a composed end frame held ~0.8–1.2 s with living
   micro-motion. Map every signature feature above to a moment. Keep one cue sheet (beats and hit times) that both the
   picture and the sound read from.
2. Key frames before motion. Build the look, render stills at 6–10 key times and actually look at them. Each still should be
   poster-worthy: composition, hierarchy, negative space, type set properly (kerning, line-height, weight contrast, CJK
   punctuation, ~5 % safe margins). Iterate until nothing looks default, generic, cramped or "AI-template".
3. Motion. Build the choreography and preview at low resolution. Step through the fastest moves frame by frame: spacing,
   easing, arcs, overlap, anticipation and follow-through, motion blur. No unintended dead spans; the energy follows the music.
4. Sound. Write genre-correct music and sound design locked to the cue sheet. Check that visual hits land on audio onsets.
   Master to the output spec.
5. Final. Render at full resolution (motion blur where apt), then check: exactly 10.00 s, resolution, fps, audio present and at
   the right loudness, no black frames, no fallback fonts or tofu, no clipped elements at the frame edges, no shimmer on thin
   lines, no gradient banding. Fix and repeat until you would submit it to a festival.
6. Write an honest self-critique: what is strongest, what is weakest, what you would do with more time.

# Rules
- Rendering must be deterministic: every frame is a pure function of time t. Seeded randomness only; physics and particles
  precomputed or closed-form; no real-time clocks; no state-triggered CSS transitions. A reliable route: a web page that can
  draw any time t on request, captured frame by frame with a headless browser and encoded with ffmpeg (or a Blender script
  that renders a PNG sequence).
- Assets: only CC0 / public domain / OFL / Apache / free-for-commercial-use. Record each source and licence in CREDITS.md.
  No real brand trademarks; invent brand names.
- On-screen text must be correct and natural: idiomatic Chinese, proper CJK punctuation, no typos.

# Craft checklist (what a jury looks for)
- Style authenticity: an expert names the style in one second; every signature technique is present and executed correctly.
- Motion craft: purposeful easing (no linear unless mechanical by design), overlap and stagger, anticipation and
  follow-through, arcs, squash and stretch where the style allows, consistent physics, motion blur where apt; transitions
  carried by elements, not crossfades.
- Rhythm: hits locked to the music; contrast between busy and calm; no monotony.
- Design: strong composition, grid, typographic hierarchy, controlled palette; texture and finishing (grain, glow, vignette)
  only where the style wants it; nothing looks accidental.
- Technical polish: no jitter (unless intended), no popping, no aliasing, no banding, no fallback fonts, no half-loaded images.
- Sound: genre-correct, musical, synced, mastered.

# Before you deliver, score yourself honestly
1–10 on style fidelity, concept wow, motion craft, design & typography, finish & texture, sound & sync, technical
(6 = template-level, 8 = high-end agency, 9 = award shortlist). Aim for 9; fix whatever scores lowest first.

# Deliver
video.mp4, plus a short report: the concept in two sentences; a beat sheet with timecodes; how each signature feature is
realised; the tech route; check numbers (duration, resolution, fps, loudness, true peak); your honest top-3 weaknesses.
```

cases.prompt:
You are the director, motion designer, engineer and sound designer of ONE 10-second motion-design film.
The goal is the most classic, yet most stunning form of this style — award-shortlist / high-end commercial quality. A clean,
template-looking result is a fail. Benchmarks: Buck, ManvsMachine, Ordinary Folk, Giant Ant, Territory Studio, Apple keynote
motion, Pentagram motion identities, top Behance/Motionographer features, top 抖音/B站 designer accounts.

# Style
粗描边贴纸人科普 MG（回形针/林超风格） Bold-outline Sticker Explainer MG (PaperClip / Lin Chao style)

# Output (fixed)
- 1920×1080, 30 fps, exactly 10.000 s (300 frames), H.264 MP4 with stereo AAC audio (48 kHz), mastered to −14 LUFS
  integrated, true peak ≤ −1 dBTP. Final file: video.mp4.

# Suggested technical route
HTML: one huge canvas (e.g. 6000×3000 px) with a camera transform (long eases), SVG charts, photo stickers with 10px white outline
(You may choose a better route if it clearly raises quality; say why.)

# Creative seed
「回形针式硬核科普」The PaperClip-style knowledge-video look: sticker-ized photos + flat icons + precise charts on a giant canvas with continuous camera moves.
- Topic (write your own tight copy), e.g. 「一部手机里，藏着多少种元素？」.
- Calm blue-grey/off-white canvas (#E9EEF2 + slate), 2–3 colours + one accent (e.g. #FF5A36); equal-weight sans typography, strict alignment.
- One continuous camera path: sticker phone photo (white 10px outline, soft shadow) → exploded-parts stickers with leader-line labels → periodic-table grid where element tiles light up → bar chart grows with count-up "70+" → world map with supply routes drawing → pull out to a bold typographic title card in the 回形针 manner (heavy sans, huge number, small caption).
- Every beat introduces a new visual element; charts are exact (bars to scale, numbers consistent).
Sound: clean tech-explainer bed, UI clicks, ticking during count-up, soft whoosh on camera moves.

You are the director: you may change the concept, copy, story beats and brand names if you find a stronger idea, but the result must remain the CANONICAL, instantly-recognisable form of this style and must hit its signature features below.

# Signature features and key techniques (the result is judged against these)
回形针 PaperClip 带火的知识区标准包装：实拍图片抠图后加粗白描边变成『贴纸』，与扁平图标、数据图表一起铺在大画布上，镜头平移缩放串联信息点；林超等财经/跨学科 UP 主将其与手写板书、公式卡片结合。至今仍是硬核科普、财经知识区、企业宣传片的主流范式。
视觉特征 照片贴纸化（粗白描边）, 蓝灰/米白冷静底色, 扁平图标+精确数据图表, 大画布镜头平移缩放, 信息密度极高的节拍化叙事
关键技法 素材照片抠图 + 8~12px 白描边统一质感，消除图片来源差异
超宽大画布布局，摄像机层做平移/缩放（ease 长曲线），一镜串多个信息点
图表动效：柱状图生长、数字滚动计数、路径描边生长
解说词逐句驱动画面元素入场，语速快、每句必有新视觉元素
克制配色（2~3 色）+ 等线字体，保持『严肃感』

# How to work
1. Treatment. Write down one clear idea: a hook in the first 0.5 s (never open on more than 0.3 s of empty or black), an
   escalation, one unmistakable hero moment at ~60–75 % of the runtime, and a composed end frame held ~0.8–1.2 s with living
   micro-motion. Map every signature feature above to a moment. Keep one cue sheet (beats and hit times) that both the
   picture and the sound read from.
2. Key frames before motion. Build the look, render stills at 6–10 key times and actually look at them. Each still should be
   poster-worthy: composition, hierarchy, negative space, type set properly (kerning, line-height, weight contrast, CJK
   punctuation, ~5 % safe margins). Iterate until nothing looks default, generic, cramped or "AI-template".
3. Motion. Build the choreography and preview at low resolution. Step through the fastest moves frame by frame: spacing,
   easing, arcs, overlap, anticipation and follow-through, motion blur. No unintended dead spans; the energy follows the music.
4. Sound. Write genre-correct music and sound design locked to the cue sheet. Check that visual hits land on audio onsets.
   Master to the output spec.
5. Final. Render at full resolution (motion blur where apt), then check: exactly 10.00 s, resolution, fps, audio present and at
   the right loudness, no black frames, no fallback fonts or tofu, no clipped elements at the frame edges, no shimmer on thin
   lines, no gradient banding. Fix and repeat until you would submit it to a festival.
6. Write an honest self-critique: what is strongest, what is weakest, what you would do with more time.

# Rules
- Rendering must be deterministic: every frame is a pure function of time t. Seeded randomness only; physics and particles
  precomputed or closed-form; no real-time clocks; no state-triggered CSS transitions. A reliable route: a web page that can
  draw any time t on request, captured frame by frame with a headless browser and encoded with ffmpeg (or a Blender script
  that renders a PNG sequence).
- Assets: only CC0 / public domain / OFL / Apache / free-for-commercial-use. Record each source and licence in CREDITS.md.
  No real brand trademarks; invent brand names.
- On-screen text must be correct and natural: idiomatic Chinese, proper CJK punctuation, no typos.

# Craft checklist (what a jury looks for)
- Style authenticity: an expert names the style in one second; every signature technique is present and executed correctly.
- Motion craft: purposeful easing (no linear unless mechanical by design), overlap and stagger, anticipation and
  follow-through, arcs, squash and stretch where the style allows, consistent physics, motion blur where apt; transitions
  carried by elements, not crossfades.
- Rhythm: hits locked to the music; contrast between busy and calm; no monotony.
- Design: strong composition, grid, typographic hierarchy, controlled palette; texture and finishing (grain, glow, vignette)
  only where the style wants it; nothing looks accidental.
- Technical polish: no jitter (unless intended), no popping, no aliasing, no banding, no fallback fonts, no half-loaded images.
- Sound: genre-correct, musical, synced, mastered.

# Before you deliver, score yourself honestly
1–10 on style fidelity, concept wow, motion craft, design & typography, finish & texture, sound & sync, technical
(6 = template-level, 8 = high-end agency, 9 = award shortlist). Aim for 9; fix whatever scores lowest first.

# Deliver
video.mp4, plus a short report: the concept in two sentences; a beat sheet with timecodes; how each signature feature is
realised; the tech route; check numbers (duration, resolution, fps, loudness, true peak); your honest top-3 weaknesses.

cases.prompt:
# 拼贴剪贴 Collage / Cutout Animation

**原片**：NOGGIN 脑洞季刊「脑洞大开 The Mind Is a Collage」 · 1920×1080 · 30 fps · 10 秒 · AI 评审终评 8.14 / 10

**源码**：[demos/06-collage/](../demos/06-collage/)

## 怎么用

1. 新建一个空文件夹，在里面打开一个能写代码、能执行命令的 AI 助手（例如 Claude Code）。本机需要能跑网页渲染（Node + Chrome）和 ffmpeg。
2. 把下面「提示词」整段复制进去发送。
3. 想换成自己的内容：改 `Creative seed` 里的故事、品牌名、文案和配色，或者改 `Output` 里的尺寸（比如竖屏 1080×1920）。不要删 `Signature features` 那一段，它是这种风格被一眼认出来的依据。
4. 想再提高：成片出来后，另开一个 AI 用 [rubric.md](../rubric.md) 评审，把评审意见贴回给制作的 AI 再改一轮。原片就是这样改了两轮。

## 提示词

```text
You are the director, motion designer, engineer and sound designer of ONE 10-second motion-design film.
The goal is the most classic, yet most stunning form of this style — award-shortlist / high-end commercial quality. A clean,
template-looking result is a fail. Benchmarks: Buck, ManvsMachine, Ordinary Folk, Giant Ant, Territory Studio, Apple keynote
motion, Pentagram motion identities, top Behance/Motionographer features, top 抖音/B站 designer accounts.

# Style
拼贴剪贴 Collage / Cutout Animation

# Output (fixed)
- 1920×1080, 30 fps, exactly 10.000 s (300 frames), H.264 MP4 with stereo AAC audio (48 kHz), mastered to −14 LUFS
  integrated, true peak ≤ −1 dBTP. Final file: video.mp4.

# Suggested technical route
HTML: DOM/Canvas with PNG cutouts from /assets/images (rembg), SVG/CSS white-edge + halftone filters; stepped 12 fps (render 30 fps, hold motion on 12 fps grid)
(You may choose a better route if it clearly raises quality; say why.)

# Creative seed
「脑洞拼贴」Surreal Dada/Monty-Python cutout collage in a modern editorial magazine finish.
- Newsprint/kraft paper ground; a public-domain Victorian portrait cutout with rough white scissor edge + halftone; the top of the head FLIPS OPEN like a lid (Terry Gilliam homage) revealing deep space (NASA PD imagery) from which flowers, birds, planets, pointing hands and a vintage rocket spill out.
- Jaw/mouth on a separate cut flaps with the sound; hands slap elements onto the page; torn-paper strips; bold constructivist red/black diagonal typography (e.g. "THE MIND IS A COLLAGE" / 脑洞大开).
- Motion on 12 fps (even 6 fps for some holds) with ±2px hand-placement jitter; paper-flip / torn-paper transition to the end card.
Sound: vinyl crackle, jazzy boom-bap bed, paper rustles, scissors snips, slaps and a comic 'pop' when the lid opens.

You are the director: you may change the concept, copy, story beats and brand names if you find a stronger idea, but the result must remain the CANONICAL, instantly-recognisable form of this style and must hit its signature features below.

# Signature features and key techniques (the result is judged against these)
把老照片、报纸、手撕纸片剪出来重新拼装的复古超现实风格，源头是 Monty Python 和苏联构成主义海报。人物头身比例失衡、嘴巴单独开合、半调网点纹理是标志。近年与'杂志风'合流，成为音乐类、街头潮流类短视频的高频风格。
视觉特征 照片剪影白描边, 半调网点, 报纸纹理, 比例失衡的超现实拼装, 定格式抽帧运动
关键技法 素材处理：人物/物件抠图后加 2~4px 白描边（剪刀剪出来的感觉）+ 半调 halftone 滤镜
关节动画：锚点设在肩/肘/颌，做 puppet 式分段旋转，嘴巴用两三张替换帧开合
刻意降帧：主体运动 12fps 甚至 6fps（stop-motion 感），位置加 ±2px 随机抖动模拟手摆
图层结构：背景纸纹 → 大形色块 → 照片剪影 → 手写涂鸦/胶带贴纸 → 颗粒调整层
转场用'手把元素拍上来'或整页翻纸

# How to work
1. Treatment. Write down one clear idea: a hook in the first 0.5 s (never open on more than 0.3 s of empty or black), an
   escalation, one unmistakable hero moment at ~60–75 % of the runtime, and a composed end frame held ~0.8–1.2 s with living
   micro-motion. Map every signature feature above to a moment. Keep one cue sheet (beats and hit times) that both the
   picture and the sound read from.
2. Key frames before motion. Build the look, render stills at 6–10 key times and actually look at them. Each still should be
   poster-worthy: composition, hierarchy, negative space, type set properly (kerning, line-height, weight contrast, CJK
   punctuation, ~5 % safe margins). Iterate until nothing looks default, generic, cramped or "AI-template".
3. Motion. Build the choreography and preview at low resolution. Step through the fastest moves frame by frame: spacing,
   easing, arcs, overlap, anticipation and follow-through, motion blur. No unintended dead spans; the energy follows the music.
4. Sound. Write genre-correct music and sound design locked to the cue sheet. Check that visual hits land on audio onsets.
   Master to the output spec.
5. Final. Render at full resolution (motion blur where apt), then check: exactly 10.00 s, resolution, fps, audio present and at
   the right loudness, no black frames, no fallback fonts or tofu, no clipped elements at the frame edges, no shimmer on thin
   lines, no gradient banding. Fix and repeat until you would submit it to a festival.
6. Write an honest self-critique: what is strongest, what is weakest, what you would do with more time.

# Rules
- Rendering must be deterministic: every frame is a pure function of time t. Seeded randomness only; physics and particles
  precomputed or closed-form; no real-time clocks; no state-triggered CSS transitions. A reliable route: a web page that can
  draw any time t on request, captured frame by frame with a headless browser and encoded with ffmpeg (or a Blender script
  that renders a PNG sequence).
- Assets: only CC0 / public domain / OFL / Apache / free-for-commercial-use. Record each source and licence in CREDITS.md.
  No real brand trademarks; invent brand names.
- On-screen text must be correct and natural: idiomatic Chinese, proper CJK punctuation, no typos.

# Craft checklist (what a jury looks for)
- Style authenticity: an expert names the style in one second; every signature technique is present and executed correctly.
- Motion craft: purposeful easing (no linear unless mechanical by design), overlap and stagger, anticipation and
  follow-through, arcs, squash and stretch where the style allows, consistent physics, motion blur where apt; transitions
  carried by elements, not crossfades.
- Rhythm: hits locked to the music; contrast between busy and calm; no monotony.
- Design: strong composition, grid, typographic hierarchy, controlled palette; texture and finishing (grain, glow, vignette)
  only where the style wants it; nothing looks accidental.
- Technical polish: no jitter (unless intended), no popping, no aliasing, no banding, no fallback fonts, no half-loaded images.
- Sound: genre-correct, musical, synced, mastered.

# Before you deliver, score yourself honestly
1–10 on style fidelity, concept wow, motion craft, design & typography, finish & texture, sound & sync, technical
(6 = template-level, 8 = high-end agency, 9 = award shortlist). Aim for 9; fix whatever scores lowest first.

# Deliver
video.mp4, plus a short report: the concept in two sentences; a beat sheet with timecodes; how each signature feature is
realised; the tech route; check numbers (duration, resolution, fps, loudness, true peak); your honest top-3 weaknesses.
```

大面积高斯模糊的彩色光斑（aurora/mesh gradient）缓慢漂移作底，磨砂半透明玻璃卡片浮在其上。苹果 iOS 26 Liquid Glass 与各家 AI 产品发布把这一风格推成 2024-2026 科技品牌片的默认视觉，气质是'慢、透、高级'。
视觉特征 大色斑高斯模糊漂移, 磨砂玻璃卡片, 1px高光描边, 邻近色低对比配色, 缓慢呼吸感节奏
关键技法 底层 aurora：3~5 个纯色大圆 blur 80~150px，各自沿贝塞尔路径 20~40 秒漂移循环，彼此 blend 出 mesh gradient 感
玻璃卡片配方：backdrop-filter blur(20~40px) + 白色 5~10% 填充 + 1px 白色 30% 内描边 + 大半径圆角
配色用邻近色 2~3 色（紫蓝青/橙粉红），撞色会脏；暗底亮斑比亮底更出效果
全局叠 3~5% 噪点防 banding（与颗粒质感技法交叉）
缓动接近 linear 或 sine 呼吸曲线，一切都慢——快动作会立刻破坏气质；文字入场也只用 opacity+8px 位移

# How to work
1. Treatment. Write down one clear idea: a hook in the first 0.5 s (never open on more than 0.3 s of empty or black), an
   escalation, one unmistakable hero moment at ~60–75 % of the runtime, and a composed end frame held ~0.8–1.2 s with living
   micro-motion. Map every signature feature above to a moment. Keep one cue sheet (beats and hit times) that both the
   picture and the sound read from.
2. Key frames before motion. Build the look, render stills at 6–10 key times and actually look at them. Each still should be
   poster-worthy: composition, hierarchy, negative space, type set properly (kerning, line-height, weight contrast, CJK
   punctuation, ~5 % safe margins). Iterate until nothing looks default, generic, cramped or "AI-template".
3. Motion. Build the choreography and preview at low resolution. Step through the fastest moves frame by frame: spacing,
   easing, arcs, overlap, anticipation and follow-through, motion blur. No unintended dead spans; the energy follows the music.
4. Sound. Write genre-correct music and sound design locked to the cue sheet. Check that visual hits land on audio onsets.
   Master to the output spec.
5. Final. Render at full resolution (motion blur where apt), then check: exactly 10.00 s, resolution, fps, audio present and at
   the right loudness, no black frames, no fallback fonts or tofu, no clipped elements at the frame edges, no shimmer on thin
   lines, no gradient banding. Fix and repeat until you would submit it to a festival.
6. Write an honest self-critique: what is strongest, what is weakest, what you would do with more time.

# Rules
- Rendering must be deterministic: every frame is a pure function of time t. Seeded randomness only; physics and particles
  precomputed or closed-form; no real-time clocks; no state-triggered CSS transitions. A reliable route: a web page that can
  draw any time t on request, captured frame by frame with a headless browser and encoded with ffmpeg (or a Blender script
  that renders a PNG sequence).
- Assets: only CC0 / public domain / OFL / Apache / free-for-commercial-use. Record each source and licence in CREDITS.md.
  No real brand trademarks; invent brand names.
- On-screen text must be correct and natural: idiomatic Chinese, proper CJK punctuation, no typos.

# Craft checklist (what a jury looks for)
- Style authenticity: an expert names the style in one second; every signature technique is present and executed correctly.
- Motion craft: purposeful easing (no linear unless mechanical by design), overlap and stagger, anticipation and
  follow-through, arcs, squash and stretch where the style allows, consistent physics, motion blur where apt; transitions
  carried by elements, not crossfades.
- Rhythm: hits locked to the music; contrast between busy and calm; no monotony.
- Design: strong composition, grid, typographic hierarchy, controlled palette; texture and finishing (grain, glow, vignette)
  only where the style wants it; nothing looks accidental.
- Technical polish: no jitter (unless intended), no popping, no aliasing, no banding, no fallback fonts, no half-loaded images.
- Sound: genre-correct, musical, synced, mastered.

# Before you deliver, score yourself honestly
1–10 on style fidelity, concept wow, motion craft, design & typography, finish & texture, sound & sync, technical
(6 = template-level, 8 = high-end agency, 9 = award shortlist). Aim for 9; fix whatever scores lowest first.

# Deliver
video.mp4, plus a short report: the concept in two sentences; a beat sheet with timecodes; how each signature feature is
realised; the tech route; check numbers (duration, resolution, fps, loudness, true peak); your honest top-3 weaknesses.

cases.prompt:
You are the director, motion designer, engineer and sound designer of ONE 10-second motion-design film.
The goal is the most classic, yet most stunning form of this style — award-shortlist / high-end commercial quality. A clean,
template-looking result is a fail. Benchmarks: Buck, ManvsMachine, Ordinary Folk, Giant Ant, Territory Studio, Apple keynote
motion, Pentagram motion identities, top Behance/Motionographer features, top 抖音/B站 designer accounts.

# Style
复古系（80s Synthwave / Y2K 千禧） Retro: 80s Synthwave / VHS / Y2K

# Output (fixed)
- 1920×1080, 30 fps, exactly 10.000 s (300 frames), H.264 MP4 with stereo AAC audio (48 kHz), mastered to −14 LUFS
  integrated, true peak ≤ −1 dBTP. Final file: video.mp4.

# Suggested technical route
HTML WebGL (perspective grid, sun, mountains shader) + canvas chrome text + CSS/SVG glow; VHS pass
(You may choose a better route if it clearly raises quality; say why.)

# Creative seed
「OUTRUN 1986」The quintessential 80s synthwave title sequence.
- Starry night, striped retro sun (horizontal band cut-outs, magenta→orange→yellow), wireframe mountains, palm silhouettes, neon magenta/cyan perspective grid rushing toward the camera.
- 0–1s: VHS tracking noise + 'PLAY ▶' OSD; 1–4s: camera flies low over the grid, sun rises; 4–6s: CHROME title (e.g. "NEON DRIVE", multi-stop metallic gradient, bevel highlight, star glint sweeping across) SLAMS in with a lens flare; 6–7.5s: pink neon script word (e.g. "Midnight") writes on like a neon tube with flicker; 7.5–10s: sustained ride, subtle VHS chroma bleed/scanlines, end on the hero frame.
- Double glow (tight ~4px + wide ~30px), deep purple sky gradient.
Sound: synthwave — gated-reverb snare, arpeggiated saw bass, lush pads, big chord + crash on the title slam.

You are the director: you may change the concept, copy, story beats and brand names if you find a stronger idea, but the result must remain the CANONICAL, instantly-recognisable form of this style and must hit its signature features below.

# Signature features and key techniques (the result is judged against these)
对特定年代媒介美学的整体引用：80s synthwave 是霓虹网格+日落渐变+镀铬字；VHS 是扫描线+色偏+磁带噪声；Y2K 千禧风是液态镀铬金属、酸性绿紫、拟物系统窗口和低保真 3D。近两年 Y2K 在音乐视频与潮流品牌片中强势回潮，B站模板市场大量供应'酸性镀铬'素材。
视觉特征 霓虹辉光, 透视网格地平线, 扫描线与RGB色偏, 镀铬金属字, 酸性配色, 拟物窗口UI
关键技法 synthwave 三件套：透视网格滚动（一点透视 grid + 纵向位移循环）、日落多层渐变球、双层辉光（内层紧 4px 高亮+外层散 30px 低透明）
VHS 做旧链：RGB split（红蓝通道各偏 1~2px）→ 扫描线（2px 间隔 10% 黑条）→ 波浪扭曲抖动（每秒 1~2 次随机 glitch 抽帧）→ 4:3 圆角遮罩
Y2K 镀铬字：极高对比的多段金属渐变 + bevel 高光 + 环境映射感反光，配 lens flare
Y2K 运动语言：弹窗式 pop 出现、光标点击、窗口拖拽，界面拟物即动画叙事
帧率故意不稳：关键段落抽帧到 15fps 或倒放 2 帧制造磁带卡顿

# How to work
1. Treatment. Write down one clear idea: a hook in the first 0.5 s (never open on more than 0.3 s of empty or black), an
   escalation, one unmistakable hero moment at ~60–75 % of the runtime, and a composed end frame held ~0.8–1.2 s with living
   micro-motion. Map every signature feature above to a moment. Keep one cue sheet (beats and hit times) that both the
   picture and the sound read from.
2. Key frames before motion. Build the look, render stills at 6–10 key times and actually look at them. Each still should be
   poster-worthy: composition, hierarchy, negative space, type set properly (kerning, line-height, weight contrast, CJK
   punctuation, ~5 % safe margins). Iterate until nothing looks default, generic, cramped or "AI-template".
3. Motion. Build the choreography and preview at low resolution. Step through the fastest moves frame by frame: spacing,
   easing, arcs, overlap, anticipation and follow-through, motion blur. No unintended dead spans; the energy follows the music.
4. Sound. Write genre-correct music and sound design locked to the cue sheet. Check that visual hits land on audio onsets.
   Master to the output spec.
5. Final. Render at full resolution (motion blur where apt), then check: exactly 10.00 s, resolution, fps, audio present and at
   the right loudness, no black frames, no fallback fonts or tofu, no clipped elements at the frame edges, no shimmer on thin
   lines, no gradient banding. Fix and repeat until you would submit it to a festival.
6. Write an honest self-critique: what is strongest, what is weakest, what you would do with more time.

# Rules
- Rendering must be deterministic: every frame is a pure function of time t. Seeded randomness only; physics and particles
  precomputed or closed-form; no real-time clocks; no state-triggered CSS transitions. A reliable route: a web page that can
  draw any time t on request, captured frame by frame with a headless browser and encoded with ffmpeg (or a Blender script
  that renders a PNG sequence).
- Assets: only CC0 / public domain / OFL / Apache / free-for-commercial-use. Record each source and licence in CREDITS.md.
  No real brand trademarks; invent brand names.
- On-screen text must be correct and natural: idiomatic Chinese, proper CJK punctuation, no typos.

# Craft checklist (what a jury looks for)
- Style authenticity: an expert names the style in one second; every signature technique is present and executed correctly.
- Motion craft: purposeful easing (no linear unless mechanical by design), overlap and stagger, anticipation and
  follow-through, arcs, squash and stretch where the style allows, consistent physics, motion blur where apt; transitions
  carried by elements, not crossfades.
- Rhythm: hits locked to the music; contrast between busy and calm; no monotony.
- Design: strong composition, grid, typographic hierarchy, controlled palette; texture and finishing (grain, glow, vignette)
  only where the style wants it; nothing looks accidental.
- Technical polish: no jitter (unless intended), no popping, no aliasing, no banding, no fallback fonts, no half-loaded images.
- Sound: genre-correct, musical, synced, mastered.

# Before you deliver, score yourself honestly
1–10 on style fidelity, concept wow, motion craft, design & typography, finish & texture, sound & sync, technical
(6 = template-level, 8 = high-end agency, 9 = award shortlist). Aim for 9; fix whatever scores lowest first.

# Deliver
video.mp4, plus a short report: the concept in two sentences; a beat sheet with timecodes; how each signature feature is
realised; the tech route; check numbers (duration, resolution, fps, loudness, true peak); your honest top-3 weaknesses.

cases.prompt:
You are the director, motion designer, engineer and sound designer of ONE 10-second motion-design film.
The goal is the most classic, yet most stunning form of this style — award-shortlist / high-end commercial quality. A clean,
template-looking result is a fail. Benchmarks: Buck, ManvsMachine, Ordinary Folk, Giant Ant, Territory Studio, Apple keynote
motion, Pentagram motion identities, top Behance/Motionographer features, top 抖音/B站 designer accounts.

# Style
像素风 Pixel Art / 8-bit

# Output (fixed)
- 1920×1080, 30 fps, exactly 10.000 s (300 frames), H.264 MP4 with stereo AAC audio (48 kHz), mastered to −14 LUFS
  integrated, true peak ≤ −1 dBTP. Final file: video.mp4.

# Suggested technical route
HTML Canvas at 320×180 internal resolution, integer-scaled ×6 with nearest-neighbour; sprites authored as pixel arrays in code; limited palette
(You may choose a better route if it clearly raises quality; say why.)

# Creative seed
「像素冒险 PIXEL QUEST」A retro side-scroller title/attract sequence.
- Internal 320×180, ×6 nearest-neighbour; limited palette (PICO-8-like 16–32 colours) with dithered sky gradient; 3–4 parallax layers (sky, far mountains, mid forest/city, near ground tiles) moving by whole pixels.
- Hero sprite (hand-authored 16×16–24×24, 6–8 frame run cycle at ~10–12 fps) runs, jumps, collects coins (sparkle), bops a slime; the palette shifts day → sunset; a treasure chest opens with a light burst.
- Dialogue box with pixel CJK font typing 「欢迎来到像素世界！」; chunky pixel logo "PIXEL QUEST" drops in with shine sweep; optional CRT pass (scanlines, slight barrel, phosphor glow) that doesn't blur pixels into mush.
- Strictly: nearest-neighbour, integer pixel positions, stepped timing (no smooth easing on sprites).
Sound: chiptune (pulse lead, triangle bass, noise drums) + jump/coin/chest SFX.

You are the director: you may change the concept, copy, story beats and brand names if you find a stronger idea, but the result must remain the CANONICAL, instantly-recognisable form of this style and must hit its signature features below.

# Signature features and key techniques (the result is judged against these)
低分辨率大颗粒像素 + 有限色板 + 低帧率精灵动画的复古游戏美学，在 B 站游戏区（MC、泰拉瑞亚、独立游戏）、8-bit 音乐 MV 和品牌怀旧营销中常见；Aseprite 教程在 B 站有 10 万+ 播放的稳定学习生态。
视觉特征 大颗粒像素与硬边缘, 有限色板(8~32色), 8~12fps 精灵帧动画, 抖动渐变 dithering, CRT 扫描线滤镜
关键技法 Aseprite 绘制精灵表（sprite sheet）+ 序列帧循环（走路 6~8 帧、呼吸 2~4 帧）
缩放必须最近邻插值（CSS image-rendering: pixelated），杜绝抗锯齿糊边
动画用 steps() 阶梯时序而非平滑缓动，保持逐帧感
视差卷轴背景：远中近三层不同速度整像素平移
可选 CRT 后处理：扫描线+桶形畸变+磷光辉光

# How to work
1. Treatment. Write down one clear idea: a hook in the first 0.5 s (never open on more than 0.3 s of empty or black), an
   escalation, one unmistakable hero moment at ~60–75 % of the runtime, and a composed end frame held ~0.8–1.2 s with living
   micro-motion. Map every signature feature above to a moment. Keep one cue sheet (beats and hit times) that both the
   picture and the sound read from.
2. Key frames before motion. Build the look, render stills at 6–10 key times and actually look at them. Each still should be
   poster-worthy: composition, hierarchy, negative space, type set properly (kerning, line-height, weight contrast, CJK
   punctuation, ~5 % safe margins). Iterate until nothing looks default, generic, cramped or "AI-template".
3. Motion. Build the choreography and preview at low resolution. Step through the fastest moves frame by frame: spacing,
   easing, arcs, overlap, anticipation and follow-through, motion blur. No unintended dead spans; the energy follows the music.
4. Sound. Write genre-correct music and sound design locked to the cue sheet. Check that visual hits land on audio onsets.
   Master to the output spec.
5. Final. Render at full resolution (motion blur where apt), then check: exactly 10.00 s, resolution, fps, audio present and at
   the right loudness, no black frames, no fallback fonts or tofu, no clipped elements at the frame edges, no shimmer on thin
   lines, no gradient banding. Fix and repeat until you would submit it to a festival.
6. Write an honest self-critique: what is strongest, what is weakest, what you would do with more time.

# Rules
- Rendering must be deterministic: every frame is a pure function of time t. Seeded randomness only; physics and particles
  precomputed or closed-form; no real-time clocks; no state-triggered CSS transitions. A reliable route: a web page that can
  draw any time t on request, captured frame by frame with a headless browser and encoded with ffmpeg (or a Blender script
  that renders a PNG sequence).
- Assets: only CC0 / public domain / OFL / Apache / free-for-commercial-use. Record each source and licence in CREDITS.md.
  No real brand trademarks; invent brand names.
- On-screen text must be correct and natural: idiomatic Chinese, proper CJK punctuation, no typos.

# Craft checklist (what a jury looks for)
- Style authenticity: an expert names the style in one second; every signature technique is present and executed correctly.
- Motion craft: purposeful easing (no linear unless mechanical by design), overlap and stagger, anticipation and
  follow-through, arcs, squash and stretch where the style allows, consistent physics, motion blur where apt; transitions
  carried by elements, not crossfades.
- Rhythm: hits locked to the music; contrast between busy and calm; no monotony.
- Design: strong composition, grid, typographic hierarchy, controlled palette; texture and finishing (grain, glow, vignette)
  only where the style wants it; nothing looks accidental.
- Technical polish: no jitter (unless intended), no popping, no aliasing, no banding, no fallback fonts, no half-loaded images.
- Sound: genre-correct, musical, synced, mastered.

# Before you deliver, score yourself honestly
1–10 on style fidelity, concept wow, motion craft, design & typography, finish & texture, sound & sync, technical
(6 = template-level, 8 = high-end agency, 9 = award shortlist). Aim for 9; fix whatever scores lowest first.

# Deliver
video.mp4, plus a short report: the concept in two sentences; a beat sheet with timecodes; how each signature feature is
realised; the tech route; check numbers (duration, resolution, fps, loudness, true peak); your honest top-3 weaknesses.

cases.prompt:
You are the director, motion designer, engineer and sound designer of ONE 10-second motion-design film.
The goal is the most classic, yet most stunning form of this style — award-shortlist / high-end commercial quality. A clean,
template-looking result is a fail. Benchmarks: Buck, ManvsMachine, Ordinary Folk, Giant Ant, Territory Studio, Apple keynote
motion, Pentagram motion identities, top Behance/Motionographer features, top 抖音/B站 designer accounts.

# Style
液态流动 Liquid Motion

# Output (fixed)
- 1920×1080, 30 fps, exactly 10.000 s (300 frames), H.264 MP4 with stereo AAC audio (48 kHz), mastered to −14 LUFS
  integrated, true peak ≤ −1 dBTP. Final file: video.mp4.

# Suggested technical route
HTML WebGL2 fragment shader: 2D SDF metaballs (smooth-min) + fake 3D lighting from field gradient normals, text SDF for the logo
(You may choose a better route if it clearly raises quality; say why.)

# Creative seed
「液态创世」Liquid logo genesis — glossy, organic, high energy.
- Deep plum ground; glossy candy liquid (hot orange → pink → violet) with specular highlights and fresnel rim so it reads like thick 3D liquid, not flat blobs.
- 0–2s: droplets fall and splash with squash on landing; 2–4s: blobs merge via metaball fusion — stretched necks, snap, 2–3 frame rebound; secondary droplets follow 2–3 frames late;
- 4–6s: a big liquid wave floods across the frame as a transition (wavy front with 3–5 phase-offset bulges);
- 6–8.5s: the liquid coalesces into a wordmark (e.g. "FLUX") — text SDF blended with the metaballs;
- 8.5–10s: a last drip falls from the logo and ripples; hold.
Ease: flung, never uniform (cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)).
Sound: bubbly gloops, pour, splash, drip, deep bass swell under a glossy synth bed.

You are the director: you may change the concept, copy, story beats and brand names if you find a stronger idea, but the result must remain the CANONICAL, instantly-recognisable form of this style and must hit its signature features below.

# Signature features and key techniques (the result is judged against these)
图形像液体一样流动、拉丝、滴落、融合：转场是一泼颜料漫过屏幕，logo 从一滴液体聚合成形。有机、解压、高能量，广泛用于音乐视频、食品饮料广告和转场包装。
视觉特征 波浪边缘转场, 拉丝与滴落, metaball融合, 次级液滴跟随, 有机曲线永不直线
关键技法 液态转场：遮罩路径手 K 波浪形前沿扫过画面，前沿加 3~5 个错相位的凸起
metaball 融合的通用伪造法：高斯模糊(20px+) → 提高对比度阈值（AE 用 Levels 收紧、Web 用 feColorMatrix alpha 阈值），两球靠近即自动'粘连'
拉丝-断裂-回弹：主形离开时留一条细颈，断裂瞬间两端各回弹 2~3 帧
缓动前快后慢 cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)，液体只会被'甩'出去不会匀速
次级液滴延迟主体 2~3 帧跟随（follow-through），落地做扁平化 squash

# How to work
1. Treatment. Write down one clear idea: a hook in the first 0.5 s (never open on more than 0.3 s of empty or black), an
   escalation, one unmistakable hero moment at ~60–75 % of the runtime, and a composed end frame held ~0.8–1.2 s with living
   micro-motion. Map every signature feature above to a moment. Keep one cue sheet (beats and hit times) that both the
   picture and the sound read from.
2. Key frames before motion. Build the look, render stills at 6–10 key times and actually look at them. Each still should be
   poster-worthy: composition, hierarchy, negative space, type set properly (kerning, line-height, weight contrast, CJK
   punctuation, ~5 % safe margins). Iterate until nothing looks default, generic, cramped or "AI-template".
3. Motion. Build the choreography and preview at low resolution. Step through the fastest moves frame by frame: spacing,
   easing, arcs, overlap, anticipation and follow-through, motion blur. No unintended dead spans; the energy follows the music.
4. Sound. Write genre-correct music and sound design locked to the cue sheet. Check that visual hits land on audio onsets.
   Master to the output spec.
5. Final. Render at full resolution (motion blur where apt), then check: exactly 10.00 s, resolution, fps, audio present and at
   the right loudness, no black frames, no fallback fonts or tofu, no clipped elements at the frame edges, no shimmer on thin
   lines, no gradient banding. Fix and repeat until you would submit it to a festival.

  precomputed or closed-form; no real-time clocks; no state-triggered CSS transitions. A reliable route: a web page that can

observations.what: 两处字标均在落定后停留满 1 秒。

所有伪随机由 index 派生，逐帧确定。

cases.prompt: 用 Remotion 制作 1920×1080、30fps、36 秒的纸墨琥珀风产品宣传片。以整页 2x 截图、元素透明底切片和 layout.json 坐标表为素材，所有页面镜头放在 2.5D 页面相机里：关键帧插值 cx、cy、zoom、rotX/Y/Z 与透视，3D 模式用 CSS zoom 做布局级放大。十个镜头依次为墨线描画与字标压印开场、聚光主角卡（聚光游走→锁定→推近侧斜→悬浮光束扫→归位）、字卡、牌堆特写后加速发牌飞入网格并搜索筛选、详情页逐行嵌入、字卡、列表堆叠压入与计数落定、字卡、周报打字机自写与历史条目逐条弹入、字卡、虚焦后元素合影组装与铅印字标砸落。字卡为衬线大字逐词入场，强调词琥珀斜体。硬切两侧各 5 帧暖白闪。音效按动作钉帧，结尾 riser→impact→sparkle，字标落定后 hold 1 秒。禁用 Date.now 与 Math.random，伪随机由 index 派生。

far / mid / main / fg 的视差系数为 0.25 / 0.55 / 1 / 1.55，远景更小、更淡。

cases.prompt: 制作一支在暖色纤维纸上自画而成的水彩纪录片：所有形体用变宽半透明色带与 3–9 条断续毛刷叠色，露出飞白，不加矢量轮廓；树干、枝、叶逐笔进入，完成后缓存精灵并轻微摇曳。纸白承担光线，场景维持三至五个色相，保留一个强调色；衬线标题、手写批注、等宽测量与中文衬线字幕相互分工。用四层视差和沿可测量梯度的连续横移组织空间，在事件处减速，用纸色雾洗回空白后画出地图。声音保留温和连续配乐、从场景材料生成的刷纸与自然声、舒缓旁白及短暂停顿，原片音轨同步播放。引擎位于 demos/cases/lemo-watercolor/film/engine.js、plants.js、scene.js 与 main.js。

七列代表 A 多利亚调七个音，十六行代表十六个八分音符，条长就是音长。

cases.prompt: 以瑞士国际主义排版制作一支纯二维动态海报片：暖灰页、白纸、黑字、浅灰格线与唯一饱和信号色，十二列画幅内左页规则右页海报，严格左齐和强烈字号反差。所有元素落在网格，所有动作在拍点到达；只用 cubic-bezier(.7,0,.2,1) 与线性，擦入与刀线删除构成转场。令一个信号色元素以线性运动离网并短暂停顿，其他单元按距离重排；海报旋转停稳后才揭示其网格是乐谱，列映射音高、行映射起音、长度映射音长。配乐逐规则加层，离网处断鼓、揭示前呼吸，保留干燥印刷拟音与原片旁白。引擎位于 demos/cases/lemo-swiss-motion/film/film.js、ease.js 与 score.json。

cases.title: 林下的田 · 点云测绘
cases.subtitle: The Fields Under the Forest
cases.summary: 康涅狄格州阿什福德的一片森林，从夏季航拍转为春季激光点云；切割面剥去树冠，地面凝成受光表面，显出 22 段、合计 3.4 公里的旧农田石墙。

observations: 点的位置保留真实回波关系，uint16 量化坐标和字节高度、分类、强度、种子控制 GPU 点云。

cases.prompt: 从真实机载激光回波制作点云测绘短片，保持每点的测量位置，用冷黑背景、克制的高度绿阶、暖中性受光地面与唯一琥珀测量强调色。照片被世界空间扫描线变为点云，镜头从俯视下降到低斜角；按离地高度逐拍下降切割面，树冠回波抬离淡出，留下真实地面点，短暂留白后由第二扫描面凝成表面。连续 C1 相机飞过墙网、推到剖面再升起，细线测量与数字来自同一数据。大号窄体读数、等宽仪器、中文标签及左下双语字幕分层；声音使用电子扫描、加速细分、凝面撞击、木质采样乐器与冷静旁白，沿用原片混音。引擎位于 demos/cases/lemo-lidar-survey/film/film.js 与 timeline.js。

cases.title: 柚子城的四季 · 孟菲斯微缩景
cases.subtitle: Four Seasons in Pomelo Town
cases.summary: 一个虚构河湾在连续高视角镜头中经历四季：广场主树每次下蹲回弹，换季波从树扩散，地面、树冠、屋顶与水面依次改色，冬日窗灯逐盏亮起。
cases.focus: 孟菲斯平色、靛蓝描边、硬紫影与世界空间纹样构成桌面模型，半秒预备动作让换季波的因果关系清楚可辨。

beats.note: 有机颗粒边框从中心长开。

beats.label: 入秋波
beats.note: 水稻变金黄，干草堆逐块出现。

beats.label: 秋日微动
beats.note: 大雁向西南飞过，落叶飘下。

beats.label: 第三次下蹲
beats.note: 主树为入冬作预备。

beats.label: 入冬波
beats.note: 浅彩树冠与白屋顶随波改变，雪在环后落下。

beats.label: 雪人弹入
beats.note: 广场雪人用回弹动作出现。

beats.label: 暮色与窗灯
beats.note: 粉紫暮色展开，窗与门灯逐盏亮起。

beats.label: 模型上的片尾
beats.note: 底部两行换为 Eian 与 LemoLab 署名。

beats.note: 村庄保持微动，有机框向中心收束。

cases.energyNote: 段落依据 DEMO.md 的 Score structure 与四季表，9.3/19.3/29.3 秒为第 3/7/11 小节重拍，36.8 秒解决到 Fmaj7，39.3 秒片尾；0–1 是伴奏厚度和画面事件密度的相对标注。
observations: 季节只改变地面、树冠、屋顶与水面的大色块，房屋主体保留色彩。
换季材质同时保存当前色和下一季色，像素在环内选择后一色，物件动作按环到达的距离延迟。
主树垂直缩至 .8，横向按 1/√sy 扩张，随后 backOut 回弹；每次都配同一组声音。
有机框和底部文字固定，镜头在 18 秒后降至 0.3 倍速度，留住池塘与村庄。

composition.color: 暖白纸 #FFFCF6、靛蓝 #25214A 轮廓、冷紫硬影、饱和孟菲斯色与季节浅彩；窗灯统一 #FFD36E。
composition.typography: Inter Tight 400/600、Noto Sans SC 400/600、IBM Plex Mono 400，三行居中排在边框下。
composition.layout: 1920×1080、60fps；约 1520×744 的有机边框容纳高三分之四视角模型，文字不覆盖场景。
composition.imagery: Three.js 几何搭建十栋房屋、桥、河、水田、主树、荷塘与远处人物，平面纹样与法线深度描边由着色器完成。
composition.motion: 一镜缓慢环绕，树木、水、鸟、舟和行人各有相位；主树下蹲回弹后发出半径变化的季节波。
composition.sound: 一首 96BPM、F 大调连续钢琴曲，四季仅改变伴奏厚度；同一下蹲对应低击、回弹音与十音竖琴上行，无旁白。
composition.rhythm: 每十秒换一季，夏雨、秋雁、冬雪和暮色灯光构成小事件，Fmaj7 延音承托片尾。
composition.coherence: 同一场地、固定日照方向、同一和声速度与重复换季手势贯穿四季。

tokens.type: Inter Tight 400/600（IT）、Noto Sans SC 400/600（SC）、IBM Plex Mono 400（PM）；按 main.js 的 TEXT 至 TITLE 字符范围与可打印 ASCII 子集化。

motion.name: 主树预备与回弹
motion.value: film/main.js:WAVES / place：8.8–9.3、18.8–19.3、28.8–29.3 秒，sy=1−.2*io；随后 .6 秒 backOut，scale.xz=1/√sy。

motion.value: film/main.js:seasonState / passed：9.3–11.9、19.3–21.9、29.3–31.9 秒，WAVE_MAX=240；passed=clamp((r−distance)/(16*len))；film/memphis.js:FLAT_FS 在环内用 uCol2。

cases.title: 剑客渡江 · 中国水墨
cases.summary: 侠客踏水过江，在静默后以书写“水”的末笔斩开巨浪；镜头拉远，整段旅程成为落有朱印的一卷山水。
cases.focus: 让笔触同时承担造型、动作与叙事，纸白成为水、雾和停顿；微小人物与浓墨巨浪建立尺度反差。
observations: 湿墨与干墨分层，前者渗化并积墨，后者留下飞白与纸齿。
人物姿势每秒12次，镜头、墨晕、水纹按24fps推进。
“水”前三笔写完后静默，末笔延伸成飞白斩线，浪在斩线完成后才分开。
结尾从局部山水拉回丝绢装裱，剑穗与落印共用唯一朱红。

composition.color: 暖宣纸、冷灰至暖黑的五色墨，朱红只落在剑穗与印章。
composition.typography: Cormorant SC 竖排题字、Cormorant Garamond 斜体题跋；Ma Shan Zheng 提供“水”的骨架。
composition.layout: 1920×1080横屏，纸白占主要空间；题跋随镜头安排在留白处。
composition.imagery: Canvas2D毛刷、写意人物与山水，WebGL2合成宣纸、渗墨、积墨和墨晕。
composition.motion: 卷轴横移、轻功跟拍、巨浪缓推、帽檐特写、末笔斩浪与指数拉远。
composition.sound: 原成片混音：古琴主导的五声音阶、箫与鼓、Kokoro bm_george旁白，静默中的水滴与剑鸣。
composition.rhythm: 虚白与墨滴开场，轻快行进后压入巨浪；两段静默托起斩击，再回到平静全景。
composition.coherence: 笔触既是形体也是动作；水面纸白与装裱中的整幅画连接局部和整体。

avoid: 多色水彩、矢量硬轮廓或密集填满画面的构图
用持续配乐覆盖决断前的静默
constraints: 笔画按索引设种子，飞白断点沿固定参考长度，保持人物局部笔触稳定。
题跋绘制时重置相机，保留每镜留白。
分浪进度从cutEnd之后计算，使斩线先完成。
山体图层底部用透明渐变收边，翻转后按实际屏幕范围放置人物。
cases.prompt: 制作一卷在暖宣纸上生成的写意水墨影片：用焦、浓、重、淡、清五色墨与加载毛刷塑形，湿层渗化积墨，干层保留飞白。纸白承担天空、水面和沉默，画面只留一处朱红并与落印呼应；人物姿势12fps，镜头、墨晕与水纹24fps。题字写在画中，斜体衬线题跋放在每镜留白。决断前真正静默，末笔先完成，浪体再沿笔势分开；结尾拉远把局部放回整幅画。古琴、箫、鼓与纸墨拟音按事件编排，沿用原片音轨。引擎位于 demos/cases/lemo-ink-wash/film/ink.js、comp.js、shots.js 与各镜头模块。

cases.title: 铸钟人 · 木刻版画
cases.summary: 冬雪封路的村庄为钟楼铸钟，第一口钟开裂后，学徒献出指南针；铜色随第二次浇铸扩散，钟声响起时雪停在空中。
cases.focus: 以黑木为底，光从逐刀刻出的痕迹中显现；反刻字经揭印转正，单一铜色只用于热量与最后的钟光。
observations: 刻痕方向跟随形体，亮处由并排的宽刀口形成。
开头沿第一刀横向追踪，随后在刻出山村的同时拉远。
标题先在反刻木版上出现，滚墨、覆纸、擦压和卷纸揭印之后读为正字。
手部以高度场照明后，转为沿明暗等高线行进的刻痕；钟声第一次出现于47.3333秒。

composition.imagery: 刻痕遮罩、单色版和WebGL2印刷合成；木桌为Poly Haven核桃木纹。
composition.motion: 逐刀显影、追刀拉远、卷纸揭印、逐拍献物、失败急推、浇铸放射刻痕与钟声拉远。
composition.sound: 原成片低弦、木皮打击、合成铁砧与钟，Kokoro am_onyx四句旁白。
composition.rhythm: 60BPM经3:2转90BPM；献物剪辑逐渐加速，两段静默分隔失败与首次钟鸣。
composition.coherence: 刻刀、印版和纸共同组织画面变化；铜色先用于表现热量，片尾收为一处钟光。

avoid: 多色平涂海报或铜版画式白底细线
